info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Etas-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare ETA Retrieval API allows users to access estimated time of arrival (ETA) information for rideshare services. This API provides real-time data on the expected wait times for rides, helping consumers make informed decisions about their transportation needs. Typical users include rideshare applications and planning tools that require up-to-date ETAs for better user experiences. By integrating this API, developers can enhance app functionality and user engagement with accurate rideshare timing insights.

get.summary: Retrieve estimated time of arrival for rides.
get.description: This endpoint provides the estimated time of arrival for available rides based on the user's current location and specified destination. It uses real-time traffic data and distance calculations to deliver accurate ETAs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the estimated time of arrival for rides. You must provide the relevant parameters to obtain an accurate ETA.

200.description: Successfully retrieved estimated time of arrival.

ListRideshareRidesEtasRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for getting estimated time of arrival (ETA) for rides. It is expected to be a string containing necessary parameters for the request.
